portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

This update is available via Red Hat Network.  To use Red Hat Network,
launch the Red Hat Update Agent with the following command:

up2date

This will start an interactive process that will result in the appropriate
RPMs being upgraded on your system.
portal_description:
Evolution includes a mailer, calendar, contact manager and communication
facility.  The tools which make up Evolution are tightly integrated with
one another and act as a seamless personal information-management tool. The
libgal2 package contains a collection of GNOME widgets and utility functions.

The following bugs have been resolved:
 - Various input methods problems 
 - Inability to remove preedit buffer cleanly in Evolution Calendar
 - Inability to commit using the [Enter] key in Calendar
 - Preedit hidden after choosing the candidate
 - Input strings were committed in the wrong order in Evolution Task
 - A problem was discovered with certain emails containing OpenOffice.org 
   attachments.  If the attachment mimetype was set to 
   "application/octet-stream", Evolution would report the attachments as
   being of type "Zip Archive Attachment."
 - A problem was discovered with printing non-roman scripts in some of
   Evolution's Calendar, Contacts and Tasks views.  Characters from 
   non-roman scripts appeared as hollow boxes when printed.  This affected 
   the Calendar component's "List View", the Contacts component's "Phone 
   List" view, "By Company" view, and any custom "Table" views, and all 
   views in the Tasks component.
 - Evolution no longer segfaults when it fails to read one of its cache 
   files

The following enhancement haa been added:
 - Russian translations are updated

All users of evolution and libgal2 should upgrade to these updated
packages, which resolve these issues and add this enhancement.
